description: This file defines the DeleteMultipleObjectsException class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling exceptions during batch delete operations in Amazon S3. It includes methods for managing error and success details related to object deletions, and implements monitoring interface traits.

classes.name: DeleteMultipleObjectsException
classes.description: Custom exception class for representing errors during batch delete operations in S3, extending PHP's base Exception class and implementing monitoring interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with arrays of successfully deleted objects and errors encountered, setting a detailed message.

methods.name: createMessageFromErrors
methods.description: Generates a combined error message string from an array of error details.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns the array of error details for objects that failed to delete.

methods.name: getDeleted
methods.description: Returns the array of successfully deleted object details.
